headline: In Danny Boyle’s ‘Ink,’ Tabloid Scandals Sell and the Public Is Buying
context: The film, which opened the Venice Film Festival on Wednesday, portrays the rise of the British tabloid The Sun in Boyle’s trademark rollicking style.
